description: The Veggie Game for Kids has an important goal:TO INTRODUCE VEGETABLES TO CHILDREN.Is it a challenge to get your child to eat vegetables? This game is the first step for your child to become familiar with vegetables.The Veggie Game will help your little ones to learn the vegetables and develop their memory skills while playing this colorful and inspiring game. Children learn where vegetables come from and how they get on the kitchen table.This application will surely keep your child occupied in an educational and constructive activity.Check it out now!4 THEMESFollowing the way of the vegetables from garden through the market to the kitchen table.1st theme: Garden with seeds2nd theme: Garden with vegetables3rd theme: At the market4th theme: In the kitchenIN EACH THEME 5 LEVELSProviding the opportunity to develop children’s learning skills and memory skills with increasing number of cards. After each successfully completed level children get rewards. Rewards represent the typical tools used in that specific theme.
